items.author: Jeb Besecker, Senior Consultant at Eigen X, Data & Analytics, Nov 18
items.summary: Built "Data Defense," a playable strategy game (28 battles, 36 units, each based on a chart type) running inside a Tableau Data App, made with Claude Code. His take: the ceiling on what you can build in Tableau "just came off." [Play](https://lnkd.in/eaKHQCgt), [GitHub](https://lnkd.in/e3EZYuMy). 52 reactions, 6 comments, 4 reposts.
